title: OKR Symphony: Initiative choreography and cross-team delivery playbook
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create and pilot a lightweight playbook ("OKR Symphony") that turns company-level OKRs into executable initiative choreographies across Product, Eng, Design, and GTM. The playbook will define how initiatives are bundled to OKRs, establish handoff contracts, create a signal fabric for dependency risk, and prescribe cadence and escalation rules to reduce blocked work and scope churn.
acceptance_criteria: Canonical OKR -> initiative mapping artifact exists and is used by 3 cross-functional initiatives in Cycle 2026-Q2
Handoff contract template (RACI + delivery SLAs) published and referenced in 4 initiative PRDs
Dependency risk fabric implemented as a dashboard with signal thresholds and on-call escalation paths
Rollout choreography playbook tested in a canary initiative with retrospective notes and measurable reduction in blocked days
